method: cross-epoch SIFT->March point index (Lowe 0.8 between distinct points) -> per-image PnP RANSAC 4 px -> 3D-3D pairs -> Sim3 RANSAC (0.25 u) -> Huber(3 px) refinement on reprojection in both epochs

transformToUVY.formula: UVY = scale * rotation @ New_SfM + translation; rotation orthogonal with det -1 (UVY is a reflected ENU frame)
